summary: A witness reported seeing someone shot at a Taco Bell in the Baker Street area. The suspect was described as a white male in his 40s to 50s, wearing a black shirt and dark pants, sitting in a white vehicle — possibly a Ford Explorer.
Fire at a vacant single-story house on King Street with flames visible inside and heavy smoke showing. Multiple engines and a truck company responded; the fire was under control by about 2:25 a.m.

Two-vehicle collision with one vehicle on fire near Gosford and Harris. Engine 14 and Engine 9 responded, with one car smoking and another about a quarter mile behind; command dubbed it the Harris Incident. Injuries unknown.

area: southbound Highway 395, north of Brown Road
summary: Multiple reports of a grass fire on southbound Highway 395 just north of Brown Road drew a large response including engines, patrol units, a water tender, dozer and helicopter. Crews found a small roadside fire that was quickly extinguished and canceled the balance.
Assault with a knife; no injuries reported. The suspect — about 6 feet tall with neck tattoos, wearing black shorts, a gray shirt and white shoes — fled on foot northbound.
Subject reported with a firearm in his waistband on Houchin Road, described as a Hispanic male in his 20s wearing a white shirt and brown pants with boots; possible unlicensed carry.
Assault reported on Birch Avenue in Wasco; medics dispatched.
Domestic incident on Fairview Road in which a woman allegedly battered a family member and stated she was going to burn down the residence.
Assault in progress with multiple people inside and a disturbance heard; suspect described as a Hispanic male with no shirt, wearing gray shorts.
Domestic violence in progress at Cardinal and Fleetwood; the suspect hit the reporting party while on the phone.
About a half acre burning behind a residence on Windsong Street; crews working with additional resources requested.
Assault in progress on the 2300 block of 18th Street; the woman involved was later reported safe at a residence on S Street after being dropped off.
Battery suspect sought — a shirtless Hispanic male with a beard, walking alongside a bike — after a woman was assaulted.
Suspicious vehicle check on Culiacan Avenue; a Honda Civic occupied by a woman in her 20s.
Family disturbance on Suncrest Drive involving an intoxicated teenager who came home; a family member was holding him down.
Welfare check on a man lying on the ground near the curb on 26th Street.
Welfare check after a neighbor was reported lying in a ditch between two residences, possibly injured; medical aid advised.
Reporting party at 20th and K attempting to flag down units, occupying a white Toyota.
Domestic disturbance on 33rd Street; a man who had been drinking was described as wearing a black shirt and black pants.
Hit-and-run on Monterey Street involving a black Camry and a white sedan.

area: 22nd Street, between Q and P streets
summary: Two fire hydrants reported spilling water on 22nd Street between Q and P streets.
A vehicle was found burned off the roadway in a field south of Kelso Creek; the driver — a woman in a blue shirt and white shorts — was seen leaving on foot.

area: southbound Interstate 5, south of Old River Road
summary: Reckless driver reported on southbound Interstate 5 south of Old River — a black Hyundai Kona speeding with erratic braking and unable to maintain its lane.

area: southbound Highway 99, south of Florida Avenue
summary: Passengers on a Greyhound bus reported the driver appeared sleepy and unable to maintain the lane on southbound Highway 99 south of Florida Avenue.
